missing_info: Actual repair time for LH-07. The 4 h minimum is mechanic's estimate by sound, not a diagnosis.
Whether LH-11 can start the move by 09:35 and whether its operator can reach 1250 to 1310 in about 1 h, since MOVE-TIME-01 says 'about'.
Whether 1310-04 has the same loading rate for LH-11 as for LH-07. I assumed the same rate.
LOADER-BACKUP-02 is a builder assumption pending validation by the project owner.
Telemetry has no failure event for LH-07 and no live positions, so the failure and the progress so far come only from the radio. I assumed constant loading rates over the productive hours.
The OT-2110 preventive hydraulic maintenance on LH-07 was overdue and the failure may be linked to it, but the data cannot confirm that.
Whether LH-07 would resume at TP-1310-04 or LH-11 would stay there after the repair.
